name: Garnier Super UV Invisible Serum Sunscreen
marketed_for: sun damage protection (sunspots, melasma, discoloration, loss of elasticity)
inci: BUTYLENE GLYCOL CITRUS LIMON FRUIT EXTRACT / LEMON FRUIT EXTRACT
search_keywords: Garnier Super UV Invisible Serum Sunscreen SPF 50 30ml
notes: Official garnier.in page; the INCI in the visible page body and in the page's schema.org JSON-LD are identical (verified 2026-11-01). The official list is missing commas in 4 places, kept verbatim here: 'ISOPROPYL MYRISTATE ETHYLHEXYL SALICYLATE', 'BIS-ETHYLHEXYLOXYPHENOL METHOXYPHENYL TRIAZINE ETHYLHEXYL TRIAZONE', 'PHENYLBENZIMIDAZOLE SULFONIC ACID PROPANEDIOL', 'BUTYLENE GLYCOL CITRUS LIMON FRUIT EXTRACT / LEMON FRUIT EXTRACT'. Each looks like 2 ingredients run together, so a parser should split them before matching. Page says it is free of oil, paraben and oxybenzone. It has fragrance and fragrance allergens (limonene, linalool, geraniol, citral, benzyl salicylate) and alcohol denat high in the list. Only one size (30ml) is listed.

name: Garnier Super UV Cooling Watergel Sunscreen
search_keywords: Garnier Super UV Cooling Watergel Sunscreen SPF 50 30ml
notes: Official garnier.in page; body INCI and JSON-LD INCI match (verified 2026-11-01). Variants: 30ml at Rs 229 (GTIN 8901526661800, the page default) and 60ml at Rs 399 (GTIN 8901526661848). GTIN-to-size mapping is confirmed by the per-variant elements on the page. The page has an unclear footnote: '*8hrs SPF 50 and 5hrs for SPF35'. Contains menthol, fragrance and fragrance allergens, alcohol denat, and colourant CI 42090.

name: Garnier Bright Complete Vitamin C Serum Cream with SPF 40/PA +++
marketed_for: skin tanning, dark spots and sunburn protection
search_keywords: Garnier Bright Complete Vitamin C Serum Cream SPF 40 45g
notes: Official garnier.in page; body INCI and JSON-LD INCI match (verified 2026-11-01). A day moisturiser with SPF, so it could also go under sunscreen. The official list ends with the batch/formula code '(C245523/1).', which I left out of the array because it is not an ingredient. The page's JSON-LD names it only 'Serum Cream SPF 40'. Niacinamide is high in the list. Contains fragrance and several fragrance allergens, plus talc.

name: Garnier Skin Naturals BB Cream
search_keywords: Garnier Skin Naturals BB Cream SPF 24 30g
notes: Official garnier.in page; body INCI and JSON-LD INCI match (verified 2026-11-01). WARNING: the page claims SPF 24, but the published INCI has no organic UV filters. The only possible UV filter is CI 77891 (titanium dioxide), and it appears only in the '+/- may contain' pigment group. Do not recommend this as primary sun protection without checking the physical pack label. The final pigment group is kept verbatim as one entry. Variants: 30g at Rs 275 (GTIN 8901526210824, the page default), 18g at Rs 160 (8901526207152) and 9g at Rs 89 (8901526210817). GTIN-to-size mapping is confirmed by the per-variant elements on the page. Shade options are not listed.

name: Garnier Bright Complete Vitamin C Serum (30X Vitamin C Booster Face Serum)

Also contains phenylethyl resorcinol, niacinamide and salicylic acid. The percentages for niacinamide and salicylic acid come from the page's product title. Variants: 15ml at Rs 225 (GTIN 8901526592616, the page default), 30ml at Rs 619 (8994993011421) and 50ml at Rs 925 (8994993016778). GTIN-to-size mapping is confirmed by the per-variant elements on the page. The 30ml is probably the main retail SKU. Contains alcohol, fragrance and fragrance allergens.

name: Garnier Bright Complete Vitamin C Serum Gel
search_keywords: Garnier Bright Complete Vitamin C Serum Gel moisturizer 45g
notes: Official garnier.in page; body INCI and JSON-LD INCI match (verified 2026-11-01). The page breaks the list across lines mid-name (e.g. 'POLYGLYCERYL-10 / LAURATE'); here the names are rejoined at the commas. The list ends with the code '(F.I.L.: Y287126/1)', which I left out because it is not an ingredient. The page says it is paraben-free, silicone-free and made with 96% natural ingredients. Note that the official URL contains Garnier's own typo ('seum-gel-moistusizer'). Contains alcohol, fragrance and fragrance allergens.

name: Garnier Bright Complete Vitamin C Face Wash
search_keywords: Garnier Bright Complete Vitamin C Face Wash 150g
notes: Official garnier.in page; body INCI and JSON-LD INCI match (verified 2026-11-01). This is a soap-based foaming cleanser made from fatty acids and potassium hydroxide, with kaolin. Despite the 'Vitamin C' name, the published INCI lists no ascorbic acid or vitamin C derivative, only lemon and yuzu (citrus junos) extracts. Variants: 150g at Rs 309 (GTIN 8901526593859, the page default), 100g at Rs 209 (8901526005208) and 50g at Rs 115 (8901526005192). GTIN-to-size mapping is confirmed by the per-variant elements on the page.

name: Garnier Men Acno Fight Anti-Pimple Face Wash
inci: CITRUS LIMON FRUIT EXTRACT / LEMON FRUIT EXTRACT
search_keywords: Garnier Men Acno Fight Anti-Pimple Face Wash 150g
notes: Official garnier.in page; body INCI and JSON-LD INCI match (verified 2026-11-01). The INCI follows a key-ingredient table on the page. Men's line. A soap-based scrub cleanser with pumice and perlite exfoliants, menthol and mineral oil. 'Herba Repair' does not map to a single INCI; the blueberry extract (Vaccinium myrtillus) is probably part of it. SIZE/GTIN: the page's JSON-LD names this 'Acno Fight Anti Pimple Face Wash 100gm' at Rs 449, but the page's own variant element ties GTIN 8901526593699 to the 150g variant at Rs 449 (the page default). Other variants, by their variant elements: 100g at Rs 299 (8901526209637), 50g at Rs 130 (8901526209620), 25g at Rs 69 (8901526563821), 100g+100g at Rs 598 (8901526558339) and 150g+150g at Rs 798 (8901526005864).
